feeds.name: 中央社 CNA 娛樂

feeds.name: 公視新聞網 PNN

feeds.name: 自由時報 生活
feeds.note: Liberty Times life section: weather, transport, health, consumer news; very frequent, short items.

feeds.name: 自由時報 蒐奇
feeds.note: Liberty Times odd-news section: short quirky human-interest stories, easy and fun.

feeds.name: 自由時報 體育

feeds.name: 自由時報 評論
feeds.note: Liberty Times editorials, columns and reader op-eds; argumentative written register.

feeds.name: ETtoday 生活
feeds.note: ETtoday life news: viral posts, weather, consumer tips; colloquial net-flavoured Mandarin. ETtoday pubDate lacks a space after the comma, so feedparser leaves published_parsed empty (dates verified current by manual parse).

feeds.name: ETtoday 旅遊
feeds.note: ETtoday travel and food: new restaurants, hotels, domestic trips, promotions. ETtoday pubDate lacks a space after the comma, so feedparser leaves published_parsed empty (dates verified current by manual parse).

feeds.name: ETtoday 寵物
feeds.note: ETtoday pet stories: short, simple, narrative posts about cats and dogs; easiest news-style reading here. ETtoday pubDate lacks a space after the comma, so feedparser leaves published_parsed empty (dates verified current by manual parse).

feeds.name: ETtoday 健康
feeds.note: ETtoday health: doctors' advice, nutrition, medical cases; body and illness vocabulary. ETtoday pubDate lacks a space after the comma, so feedparser leaves published_parsed empty (dates verified current by manual parse).

feeds.name: ETtoday 新奇
feeds.note: ETtoday odd news from around the world; short and casual. Feed mixes in a few old items. ETtoday pubDate lacks a space after the comma, so feedparser leaves published_parsed empty (dates verified current by manual parse).

feeds.name: Rti 中央廣播電臺
feeds.note: Radio Taiwan International news; feed carries the full article text (440-800 chars in sampled items), broadcast-news style.

feeds.name: 地球圖輯隊
feeds.note: Photo-led explainers of international stories written in plain conversational Mandarin for young readers.

feeds.name: 國語日報
feeds.note: Mandarin Daily News, Taiwan's children's newspaper: 8 short simple news items per day. Dates are YYYY/MM/DD (non-RFC822; verified current by hand).

feeds.name: 報導者 The Reporter
feeds.note: Non-profit investigative journalism; long in-depth features (sample article 4,400 chars) in literary reportage style. URL is the redirect target of twreporter.org/a/rss2.xml.

feeds.name: 關鍵評論網 The News Lens
feeds.note: News explainers, commentary and translated analysis across politics, society, culture.

feeds.name: 思想坦克 Voicettank

feeds.name: 巷仔口社會學

feeds.name: 歷史學柑仔店
feeds.note: Public-history essays by Taiwanese historians; long-form with classical quotations.

feeds.name: 泛科學 PanSci

feeds.name: 研之有物 中研院

feeds.name: 台灣事實查核中心
feeds.note: Fact-check reports that restate a rumour and walk through the evidence; clear, structured expository prose.

feeds.name: 科技新報 TechNews

feeds.name: INSIDE

feeds.name: 女人迷 Womany
